from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
gate=json.loads((out/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
source_protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
parent=json.loads((root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert gate['all_16_source_gate_passed'] and sha(out/'季度借款两渠道状态.parquet')==gate['quarter_field_hash']
assert not (out/'model_protocol.json').exists() and not (out/'run_started.json').exists()
fields=source_protocol['fields'];control=parent['features_control']
model={'study_id':source_protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E12','registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
    'phase':'SINGLE_FIXED_TWO_CHANNEL_JOINT_INCREMENT',
    'hypothesis':'现金假设落差/目标调整与扣现金后净借款需要代表不同约束，在相同国内需求、资金、融资和量价状态下可能对应不同剩余收益；不预设方向。',
    'source_gate_status':gate['status'],'source_quarter_roots':16,'fields':fields,
    'known_history':'E1—E11及原M2/E6/E9历史结果已看过；E12原字段已在E11看过，当前E12收益比较尚未读取，不是独立历史验证。',
    'event_universe':parent['event_universe'],'features_control':control,'features_joint':control+fields,
    'comparison_reason':'与E6同国内事件及月份控制，只检验两新观察渠道增量；不重开单项长端供给或准备金周度失败模型。',
    'source_join':'available_at<=原decision_at的最近原季度；事件年份2022—2025、来源年龄<=120天。全68原事件逐条保存未准入原因，不将季度值复制为新事件。',
    'source_root_dependence':'训练/评分的季度根及每根复用次数保存；事件多于16不代表宏观独立根增加。',
    'feature_units':'两项均直接用十亿美元；不按收益选择除数/正负符号/现金占比；线性参考只依训练池标准化。',
    'training':parent['training'],'tree':parent['tree'],
    'comparisons':['同事件/同池11变量国内控制树','同事件/同池13变量两渠道联合树','同13变量标准化岭回归alpha10仅参考','同成熟池标签平均'],
    'label':parent['label'],'score':parent['score'],'evaluation':parent['evaluation'],
    'primary_period':parent['primary_period'],'earlier_context':parent['earlier_context'],
    'increment_gate':{'primary_joint_mse_not_worse_than_matched_control':True,
        'primary_joint_high_mean_net5_positive':True,
        'primary_joint_high_mean_not_worse_than_matched_control_when_nonempty':True,
        'at_least_one_primary_joint_high_window_not_in_control_or_parent_M2':True,
        'at_least_one_primary_new_high_path_actually_uses_cash_or_remainder':True},
    'account_admission':'全部固定增量条件通过后另登记20万/2万元完整连续账户；不把高分事件收益当完整账户夏普，不以线性参考/早期点值营救。账户原目标及风险合同保留。',
    'account_targets':{'net_sharpe':1.2,'cagr':0.1,'max_drawdown':0.1,'minimum_cycles_each_full_year':5},
    'parameter_searches':0,'source_code_edits':0,'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
    'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET'}
p=out/'model_protocol.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(model,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
inputs=['reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet',
    'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/全部固定高分机会.csv',
    'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/daily_inputs_corrected_20240808.parquet',
    'research/multidim_money_surprise_score_v1.py','research/multidim_nonlinear_score_v1.py',
    'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/protocol.json',
    'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/result.json',
    'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1/result.json']
freeze={'registered_at':model['registered_at'],'before_E12_equity_event_labels_or_fits':True,
    'model_protocol_sha256':sha(p),'source_protocol_sha256':sha(out/'protocol.json'),
    'source_gate_sha256':sha(out/'source_gate.json'),'quarter_field_sha256':gate['quarter_field_hash'],
    'input_hashes':{rel:sha(root/rel) for rel in inputs},
    'risk_contract_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['account_tail_risk_contract'],
    'execution_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],'model_selection_or_parameter_searches':0}
(out/'model_freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E12唯一模型比较已登记：原11项对照、加两渠道13项联合；两层/每叶6/504日/至少12成熟事件，原五日标签与主期不变。')
